title: The Research Methodology Database — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Real information from reliable public sources and official catalogs, fact-checked reference. Qualitative, quantitative, experimental, and mixed-method methods, explained for use. The Research Methodology Database documents research methods as usable protocols: when each method fits, the steps to run it, sampling and measurement choices, validity threats, and how to report results. Methods span qualitative, quantitative, experimental, and mixed designs. The Signature side adds decision trees that route a research question to suitable methods and warn about common design mistakes.
